name: seated-alternate-dumbbell-lateral-raise.html
instructions:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells with a neutral grip and sit on the edge of a flat bench with your feet around shoulder width apart. This is the starting position for the exercise.
2. Slowly raise one dumbbell to around shoulder height. Pause, and then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
3. Immediately repeat the movement on the other arm. This is one rep.
4. Repeat for the desired rep range.
